                                                                                    Full job description

                                                                                    The Cervantes Group is seeking to hire a dynamic and passionate Data Analyst to join our team. The chosen candidate will turn data into information, information into insight, and insight into business decisions. An analytic, numbers-driven professional, the Data Analyst will utilize extensive data sets to draw insights and make informed business decisions.

                                                                                    Key Responsibilities:

                                                                                      • Collecting and interpreting data from multiple sources, then convert it into actionable insights.
                                                                                      • Analyze trends, patterns and relationships in data and construct predictive models to achieve organizational objectives.
                                                                                      • Deliver reports to the upper management and formulate strategies to solve business problems.
                                                                                      • Monitor data integrity and quality, and correct any inconsistencies.
                                                                                      • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement data-driven solutions.
                                                                                      • Develop and manage data visualization tools and databases.
                                                                                      • Communicating and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

                                                                                    Qualifications:

                                                                                      • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field required. A Master's Degree is preferred.
                                                                                      • At least 2 years' experience in data analysis or a related role.
                                                                                      • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
                                                                                      • Proficiency in using query languages such as SQL, R and Python.
                                                                                      • Knowledge in statistical methodologies and data modeling is a plus.
                                                                                      • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI, etc.
                                                                                      • Strong presentation and communication skills to explain complex concepts to non-technical clients.
                                                                                      • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced and rapidly-changing environment.

                                                                                    Benefits:

                                                                                      • A robust healthcare package, including dental and vision coverage.
                                                                                      • Generous vacation and time-off policies.
                                                                                      • Comprehensive retirement plans.
                                                                                      • Professional development programs for continued learning and growth.
                                                                                      • Cutting-edge technological environment.
                                                                                      • A collaborative, inclusive, and flexible work culture.

                                                                                    The Data Analyst at The Cervantes Group will play a critical role in refining our data-driven culture, regularly interfacing with leaders across the organization to assist in decision-making. This position is a fantastic opportunity for those with a genuine interest in the power of data to influence strategic decision-making at a vibrant and growing organization.
